name: Stoop Palm
description: Drop onto the target with an open palm and the whole body's weight falling together behind it.

name: Wing Guard
description: Spread both arms like folded wings across the chest and take the blow on their outer edge.

name: Hawk Step
description: Hop forward on the balls of both feet to land square under the target with the frame loaded.

name: Stoop Surge
description: Gather qi high in the shoulders and back so the next falling blow carries a heavier mass.

name: Diving Fist
description: Leap and bring the fist down on the target's head or shoulder with the weight of the fall.

name: Rising Hand
description: Thrust the palm up under the target's chin so the head snaps back and the guard opens.

name: Azure Breath
description: Draw a deep breath of clean qi and push the dulling sluggishness of poison from the user or an ally.

name: Hawkfall Blow
description: Fall from above with both fists joined so the whole weight of the descent lands in one point.

name: Winged Rebuke
description: Sweep an incoming blow wide with one arm and bring the other down in the opening it makes.

name: Titanstoop
description: Plunge from a height with the qi field wrapped around both fists so the blow pierces guard and ground alike.

name: Bench Palm
description: Strike with a palm held level and square as a judge's hand falls on a table.

name: Bench Brawnguard
description: Hold both fists before the body in a matched pair so blows find the same braced answer on each side.

name: Twin Pace
description: Step with each foot in turn at an even pace so that the weight is shared by both legs.

name: Judging Fist
description: Test the guard with one fist and judge the opening so the second can fall exactly where it must.

name: Pincer Press
description: Bear down on the target from both sides so that it may neither strike nor withdraw.

name: Twin Surge
description: Send equal surges of qi into both hands so that the paired fists carry the same force.

name: Twin Sentence
description: Land two fists on the same point one beat apart so the second finishes what the first began.

name: Bare Verdict
description: Pass judgment with a blow that strips the target of its guard and its will to rise.

name: Gavel Fall
description: Bring both fists down together like a gavel so the ground shakes and the target reels under it.

name: Current Palm
description: Sweep the palm along the target's guard like a current that finds and widens a gap.

name: Current Slide
description: Let a blow slide along the forearms as water slides along a bank without moving the body.

name: Flowing Step
description: Flow around the target's reach in a smooth arc with the weight sinking into each foot.

name: Swelling Might
description: Let qi rise in the limbs like a swelling river until strength overflows its banks.

name: Shift Reading
description: Feel the flow of a target's weight through contact to find which way it will shift next.

name: Current Press
description: Press steadily on the target like a current and carry it back step by step.

name: Flowing Heave
description: Take hold and heave with a smooth rolling motion that sweeps the target off its feet.

name: Clear Flow
description: Let clean qi run through the limbs like fresh water and wash taint or numbness from the user or an ally.

name: Torrent Barrage
description: Pour a torrent of heavy blows onto one point with no gap for the target to answer.

name: Flood Palm
description: Push a broad flood of force outward from the palm that strikes everything before the user.

name: Deluge Mass
description: Loose the whole stored weight of the body in one deluge that floods a wide front and flattens it.

name: Dual Palm
description: Strike with one palm while the other runs a second line of qi alongside it.

name: Dual Brace
description: Hold a guard on the body and a second guard on the qi field so neither fails alone.

name: Track Step
description: Run one foot along the line of attack and the other along the line of guard.

name: Track Surge
description: Run qi down two tracks at once so that force and guard rise together.

name: Parallel Strike
description: Throw two blows along parallel lines so that the target cannot guard both.

name: Crossing Guard
description: Cross the two tracks of guard so a blow from any side meets a braced arm.

name: Dual Rouse
description: Rouse both tracks of the body at once to raise strike and guard together in the user or an ally.

name: Dual Rending
description: Tear at the guard from two tracks at once so that it splits along the line between them.

name: Crossed Rebuke
description: Cross the arms to catch a blow and spring them open in a double strike that follows.

name: Dual Colossus
description: Seize and strike along both tracks together with a mass that holds the target while it breaks.

name: Azure Hand
description: Strike with a palm lit by blue-tinged qi and the weight of a great frame behind it.

name: Azure Brawnshell
description: Wrap the body in a clear and level layer of qi that takes blows as the open sky takes rain.

name: Azure Heavystride
description: Take a long and unhurried stride that moves a huge body smoothly through a tight space.

name: Azure Brawnrise
description: Raise the body's qi to a level calm and wide so that the frame swells with force.

name: Azure Appraisal
description: Let the qi field spread wide to feel the size and strength of anything that nears.

name: Hulking Fist
description: Swing a fist as large as a head from the full reach of an arm swollen with qi.

name: Looming Guard
description: Loom over the target with arms wide so that the guard covers the user and anyone behind.

name: Looming Press
description: Lean the whole great frame over a target until it cannot find room to swing.

name: Azure Vigor
description: Pass the calm rise of qi onto an ally by touch so the ally's muscle swells with strength.

name: Looming Ruin
description: Come down on the target with the great frame and hold it under the weight while it breaks.

name: Cerulean Crush
description: Swing a fist wrapped in dense blue qi through the guard so that the force crushes whatever lies behind.

name: Titanwrath
description: Bring all the wrath of a titan's frame down in one blow that flattens the target and its footing.

name: Titan Hand
description: Swing the palm in a wide arc with the sheer reach of a titan's arm.

name: Titan Guard
description: Plant the frame like a titan at rest and turn blows with a body no push will shift.

name: Titan Pace
description: Stride with the slow and deliberate weight of a titan that arrives wherever it intends.

name: Titan Grip
description: Close a vast hand on the target and keep it fast as a titan keeps a captive.

name: Titan Heave
description: Lift the target high on both hands and cast it down with the weight of a titan.

name: Titan Draw
description: Draw deeply on the body's reserve of strength so the user or a touched ally grows heavy with might.

name: Titan Hammer
description: Bring the joined fists down like a hammer of mass that no guard can bear.

name: Titan Rebuke
description: Throw back a heavy blow with a forearm that returns the force with a titan's weight added.

name: Titan Sundering
description: Split the target's guard and frame with a single blow carrying the full mass of a titan.

name: True Knuckle
description: Throw a fist that has been sworn to fall straight and true on its mark.

name: Sworn Stand
description: Set the body in a brace sworn not to yield until the blow has spent itself.

name: Oathbound Stride
description: Walk the bearing at a sworn pace that speeds up or slows for nothing the target does.

name: Sworn Brawndraw
description: Draw on the oath to bring up reserves of strength the body would not otherwise offer.

name: Oath Hammer
description: Bring the closed fist down on the target like a hammer sworn to a single nail.

name: Oath Shove
description: Shove with the whole sworn frame so the target is driven back and held back.

name: Oath Rouse
description: Speak the oath to an ally and rouse its tired limbs with a surge of steadying qi.

name: Oathcrush
description: Crush the target's guard with a blow sworn never to turn aside from what it breaks.

name: Oath Turning
description: Turn an attack aside by the oath-held arm and return it along the line it came.

name: Oath Colossus
description: Rise as a titan sworn to one purpose and bring it down on the target in a single binding blow.

name: Unmoved Hand
description: Strike from a stance that has not shifted so the blow lands with the full weight of the ground.

name: Unmoved Posture
description: Fix the stance until a push or a blow finds it as unyielding as a mountain's root.

name: Frame Pace
description: Move the whole frame as a single mass one step at a time without breaking its set.

name: Frame Draw
description: Draw qi into the bones of the frame until the whole body holds a firmer and heavier set.

name: Frame Appraisal
description: Gauge the soundness of the user's own frame and any strain or flaw within it.

name: Immutable Guard
description: Hold a guard that does not change however hard or often it is struck.

name: Frame Hammer
description: Swing the whole unmoving frame as a hammer through a single turn of the hips.

name: Frame Cleanse
description: Steady the stance and let the sworn calm drive the weakness of taint out of the limbs.

name: Unmoved Ruin
description: Break the target against a stand that does not move so the blow lands with all its weight.

name: Unmoved Rebuke
description: Meet the blow with a stand that does not yield and return its force through a counter.

name: Unbroken Crush
description: Crush the target with a frame that no blow has marked and press it flat in a single stroke.

name: Open Fist
description: Strike with an open fist from the full stretch of the arm and hide nothing of the motion.

name: Open Footing
description: Stand with arms spread and unhidden and let the qi around the body turn each blow aside.

name: Naked Stride
description: Stride into the open with the full body in plain sight and the weight carried forward.

name: Open Press
description: Press out with both palms so the force fills the space between user and target.

name: Open Heave
description: Seize and heave in plain view so the target is thrown aside before it can brace.

name: Open Surge
description: Let qi spread out through the whole body in the open so that every limb gains force.

name: Unwalled Strike
description: Strike with no cover and no hesitation so the force of the whole body arrives at once.

name: Unwalled Rebuke
description: Meet a blow in the open and answer it with a stroke that hides nothing and misses nothing.

name: Unwalled Titan
description: Fill the open field with the weight of a titan's blow that strikes everything within the user's reach.

name: Long Palm
description: Strike along a long bearing so the palm carries the weight of a full stride behind it.

name: Long Brace
description: Hold the brace for as long as the exchange lasts without a tremor in the stance.

name: Long Tread
description: Take a long and level stride that covers ground without lifting the body's weight.

name: Long Draw
description: Draw qi slowly and steadily so strength lasts through the longest exchange.

name: Long Haul
description: Drag the target a long way along the bearing and fling it down at the end.

name: Long Press
description: Hold a pressure on the target that does not lessen however long it resists.

name: Long Breath
description: Take one long breath and let qi wash the poison or weariness from the user or an ally.

name: Bearing Hammer
description: Bring a hammer of held weight down along the bearing and land it where the target stands.

name: Bearing Counter
description: Turn the bearing against an attacker's force and send it back with the weight of the stance.

name: Unending Crush
description: Crush and keep crushing as the bearing is held and the weight grows without ceasing.

name: Burden Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the whole borne weight of the body behind it.

name: Burden Guard
description: Take a blow while bearing a load and let the load itself absorb part of the shock.

name: Burden Step
description: Step firmly under a heavy burden and keep the bearing without a stagger.

name: Burden Draw
description: Draw strength into the legs and back to lift a weight that would crush a lesser frame.

name: Burden Test
description: Test the weight of the load and of the body bearing it and learn which will give first.

name: Burden Ram
description: Drive forward under the burden so the full mass of load and body rams the target.

name: Heavy Bearing
description: Hold a bearing under a great weight so no blow can move the body from its line.

name: Burden Purge
description: Cast off the sapping weight of curse or poison by driving qi out through the straining limbs.

name: Burden Rouse
description: Rouse an ally to bear a greater weight by sharing the user's qi along the arms and back.

name: Burdenfall
description: Let the whole borne weight drop through the fist onto the target in one crushing fall.

name: Burden Rebuke
description: Catch a blow on the loaded frame and return it magnified by the weight carried.

name: Crushing Burden
description: Loose the whole borne weight as a wave that crushes and holds down every target before the user.

name: Heavy Fist
description: Throw a fist heavier than its size with the oath of the sworn hand behind it.

name: Heavy Parry
description: Knock an incoming blow aside with a heavy forearm that outweighs the strike.

name: Heavy Pace
description: Move with a heavy and level pace that eats the distance and gives up no balance.

name: Heavy Draw
description: Draw qi into the hand until it weighs more than its bones and strikes as a hammer does.

name: Heavy Hammer
description: Hammer down with the heavy hand in a sworn blow that will not be turned.

name: Heavy Clasp
description: Close the heavy hand on a limb and hold it against every attempt to pull free.

name: Heavy Surge
description: Send a heavy surge of qi into the hands of an ally so its blows land with weight.

name: Heavy Ruin
description: Ruin the target's guard and balance with one stroke of the sworn heavy hand.

name: Heavy Rebuke
description: Turn aside a blow with the heavy hand and return a stroke that is far weightier.

name: Ruinhand
description: Drive the sworn hand through the target's guard and frame in a single blow of utter ruin.
